source.title: 3. Prevention or Delay of Diabetes and Associated Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026

schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; guideline recommendations are represented as author_conclusion with descriptive tags.

The quantitative-result model is oriented toward primary studies; secondary narrative ranges or comparisons that do not map cleanly to one estimate are preserved as qualitative_result, other, or author_conclusion rather than forcing artificial numeric structure.
limitations: Cited primary studies were not independently read in this pass; secondary-reported results remain anchored to the ADA chapter.
Full ADA guideline-development methodology and evidence-grade definitions are delegated to the separate Introduction and Methodology and are not contained in this chapter.
The printed HLA-DR4 teplizumab subgroup confidence interval is malformed (“09.0.45”); it was flagged rather than silently corrected.
